thread.title: Morgan Stanley Cuts Apple (AAPL) Price Target to $211.00

author: ABMN Staff
title: Morgan Stanley Cuts Apple (AAPL) Price Target to $211.00
text:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its price target reduced by Morgan Stanley from $236.00 to $211.00 issued on Thursday, The Fly reports. The firm presently has an “overweight” rating on the iPhone maker’s stock. Morgan Stanley’s target price indicates 33.61% from the stock’s current price.
AAPL has been the topic of several other research reports. BidaskClub cut shares of Apple from a “strong-buy” rating to a “buy” rating on Wednesday, September 12th. JPMorgan Chase & Co. reissued a “buy” rating and set a $272.00 Apple on Wednesday, October 10th. HSBC cut shares of Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and set a $181.37 price target on the stock. on Sunday, December 9th. Royal Bank of Canada reissued a “buy” rating and set a $240.00 Apple on Tuesday, September 11th. Finally, Wells Fargo & Co set a $210.00 Apple and gave the company a “neutral” rating on Wednesday, September 5th. Three research twenty-six have given a hold rating and twenty-one have assigned a buy rating to the company’s stock. The stock presently has a consensus rating of “Hold” and an average price target of $212.57.
